annotations.title: Purge Enclave Job Vault (Authenticated Owner Only)

description: Authenticated job-owner security action: immediately shred and cryptographically overwrite all single-job CAD workspace artifacts (input.kicad_pcb, routed.kicad_pcb, and Gerber .zip archives) inside the cloud enclave and issue a signed SHA-256 deletion receipt. Call this destructive tool when an enterprise customer demands immediate manual zero-retention erasure prior to the automatic 24-hour TTL. Requires job_id and the job owner's per-job secret job_access_token returned at job creation. Returns JSON with status='VAULT_PURGED_ZERO_RETENTION_VERIFIED', files_shredded_count, and deletion_receipt_sha256, or AUTH_ERROR if job_access_token is missing or invalid.

customer_email.description: Optional customer email address matching the job owner record for audit logging. Example: 'sec@company.io'.

download_token.description: Optional alias for job_access_token (HMAC-SHA256 receipt or download authorization token proving ownership of job_id). Example: 'tok_8f9d2a1b'.

job_access_token.description: Per-job secret purge/download authorization token (minLength 8) returned at job creation or payment receipt verification to authenticate destructive vault erasure.

job_id.description: Unique job identifier whose enclave workspace artifacts should be permanently shredded. Example: 'job_01'.

name: calligraphy_purge_job_vault
title: Purge Enclave Job Vault (Authenticated Owner Only)
